name: Tennis Scores API → daily rows (Apify, publicrecords)

nodes.name: Run Tennis Scores API on Apify
nodes.notes: Create a Header Auth credential: name = Authorization, value = Bearer <your Apify API token> (console.apify.com/settings/integrations). Runs bill to your own Apify account at the Store price. This Actor has no hosted MCP / Standby endpoint.

parameters.content:
## Tennis Scores API
ATP and WTA match scores, results and rankings (set-by-set scores, tiebreaks, seeds, winner).

Store page: https://apify.com/publicrecords/tennis-scores-api
Call the Apify API with your own token. Standby/MCP mode is not built; this workflow does not use an MCP endpoint.

Edit the JSON body to change the input, then connect the output to Google Sheets, Slack, Airtable or email.
